entries.justification: Owned operational instruction imposes this action constraint: Kestrel may load plugin versions from 3.2.0 inclusive to 3.5.0 exclusive, except version 3.3.4.
Owned operational instruction imposes this action constraint: Calyx writes are prohibited from 22:00 to 23:00 UTC on November 10, 2026.
Owned operational instruction imposes this action constraint: Lumen must merge concurrent shard revisions before choosing a single active buffer size.
Owned operational instruction imposes this action constraint: Oriel must enter read-only mode when a checksum fails; an operator may also select read-only mode without checksum failure.
